svg.title: 3.3 Workflow: diagnosing "my data is in the wrong place"
svg.desc: Rendered directly from the complete Mermaid definition in core-geospatial-concepts.md. All nodes, labels and relationships are retained.

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p: Data appears in the wrong place

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p: Is a CRS declared on the data?

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p: Find metadata or source documentation, then ASSIGN the CRS without transforming

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p: Do coordinate magnitudes fit the declared CRS?

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p: Declared CRS is wrong: assign the correct CRS, do not reproject

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p: Are x and y mirrored, for example latitude used as longitude?

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p: Axis order error: swap x and y, or use always_xy at the boundary

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p: Is the shift small, decimetres to a few metres?

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p: Datum transformation missing or ballpark: choose a proper operation or grid shift

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p: Check units, mixed CRSs in one layer, on-the-fly reprojection and extent filters
